# Functions

To reduce code, we will generate some functions here. 
```{r definition, echo = F}
# function to generate a vulcano plot for differentially expressed genes
GenerateVolcanoPlot <- function(fit, variable, file, cols) {
  # get all hits
  hits <- topTable(fit, coef = variable, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
  total <- nrow(hits)
  # get first hit after FDR 10% for drawing a p-value threshold line
  index <- if(length(which(hits$adj.P.Val < 0.1)) == 0) 0 else which(hits$adj.P.Val < 0.1)
  threshold <- hits[index[length(index)] + 1, "P.Value"]
  # set colors
  hits$color <- "black"
  if (length(hits[hits$adj.P.Val < 0.1, "adj.P.Val"]) != 0) {
    hits[hits$adj.P.Val < 0.1, ]$color <- cols
  }
  ### volcano plot ###
  # label only top 10 significant hits
  g <- ggplot(hits, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value), color = color)) + 
    theme_classic(base_size = 22) + 
    theme(panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, size = 2), axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) +
    geom_point(color = hits$color) + 
    xlim(-1, 1) + 
    ylim(0, 6) +
    xlab(bquote(~Log[2]~ "fold change")) +
    ylab(bquote(~-Log[10]~ italic(P))) +
    labs(caption = paste0("Total variables: ", total)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(threshold), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_text_repel(data = hits[1:10, ], aes(label = gene_name), colour = hits[1:10, "color"])
  g
  ggsave(file = paste0(outpath, "/", file), width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")
}

# function to generate a vulcano plot for differentially expressed genes

# function to plot all differentially expressed hits for the different covariates corrected for all other covariates as a vertical barplot
GenerateVerticalBarplotOfDiffExprHits <- function(design, fit, from, to, plot_name){
  # Get padj values for all different covariates
  nc <- ncol(design) - 1
  limma_res_fc <- topTable(fit, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "none", number = Inf)
  limma_res_padj <- limma_res_fc[, from:(to + nc)]
  for (i in 1:nc){
    limma_res_padj[, i] = topTable(fit, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "none", number = Inf, coef = i + 1)[, "adj.P.Val"]
    if(i == nc){
      limma_res_padj$`Ensembl Gene ID` = topTable(fit, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "none", number = Inf, coef = i + 1)[, "gene_id"]
    }
  }
  limma_res_padj <- limma_res_padj[, -c(length(limma_res_padj) - 1)] # remove SV1
  colnames(limma_res_padj) <- c("Diagnosis", "Age", "Sex", "pH", "PMI", "RIN", "RIN2", "Suicide", "Type_of_Death1", "Type_of_Death2", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "Ensembl Gene ID")
  limma_res_padj$Type_of_Death <- (limma_res_padj$Type_of_Death1 + limma_res_padj$Type_of_Death2) / 2
  limma_res_padj <- limma_res_padj[, c("Diagnosis", "Age", "Sex", "pH", "PMI", "RIN", "RIN2", "Suicide", "Type_of_Death", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "Ensembl Gene ID")]
  # unmerge Gene Ensembl IDs at their vertical dash "|"
  limma_res_padj <- unique(separate_rows(limma_res_padj, `Ensembl Gene ID`, sep = "\\|")) 
  # change data.frame into data.table to get the minimal adjusted p-value for each unique Ensembl Gene IDs (some can be found multipe times!!)
  limma_res_padj <- as.data.table(limma_res_padj)
  limma_res_padj <- limma_res_padj[, lapply(.SD, min), by = 'Ensembl Gene ID']
  # check, how many padj values are < 0.10
  limma_res_padj_0.1 <- apply(limma_res_padj[, -1], 2, function(x) sum(x < 0.1))
  limma_res_plot <- data.frame(sort(limma_res_padj_0.1, decreasing = T))
  # vertical barplot with ggplot2
  g <- ggplot(limma_res_plot, aes(y = sort.limma_res_padj_0.1..decreasing...T., x = reorder(row.names(limma_res_plot), sort.limma_res_padj_0.1..decreasing...T.))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_classic(base_size = 22) +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 22), panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, size = 2), axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) +
    ylab("# significant hits") +
    xlab("") +
    geom_text(size = 7, aes(label = sort.limma_res_padj_0.1..decreasing...T.), nudge_y = 120, colour = "dimgray") + 
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.01))
  ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(outpath, "/", plot_name))
  return(limma_res_plot)
}

# function to load the PRS all score file, change the colnames into right order and return only IID and 0.01 PRS
GetPRS <- function(filename){
  all_scores <- suppressWarnings(fread(filename, stringsAsFactors = F))
  # set colnames right 
  names <- colnames(all_scores)[-1] # remove first colname and save all others
  all_scores$`1` <- NULL # remove last column with NAs
  colnames(all_scores) <- names # set right colnames
  # return only IID and PRS for 0.01
  score <- all_scores[, c("IID", "0.01")]
  return(score)  
}

# function, which first generates the contingency table for two datasets and then calculates the p-value using fisher exact test
# return: the p-value calculated using fisher exact test
FishersExactTest <- function(data1, data2, background){
  data1  <- unique(sort(unlist(data1)))
  data2 <- intersect(data2, background)  # take only the genes, which are also in the background data
  a <- length(intersect(data1, data2))  # all genes in data1 and data2
  b <- length(data1) - a  # all genes in data1, but NOT in data2
  x <- length(setdiff(data2, data1))  # all genes in data2, but NOT data1
  y <- length(background) - length(data1) - x  # all genes NOT in data1 or data2
  contingency_matrix <- matrix(c(a, x, b, y), 2, 2)
  #print(contingency_matrix)
  result <- fisher.test(contingency_matrix, alternative = "greater")
  return(result$p.value)
}

# function to generate a forest plot for a given gene: showing a horizontal line from lower to upper 95% confidence interval and a dot in the middle representing the mean log2FC for the gene, its transcripts and exons. The FDR will only be plotted for the gene for the normal model and one transcript and one exon based on the new FDR model.
GenerateForestPlot <- function(gene) {
  # we will save following order of IDs for the plot: 1. Gene ID, 2. Transcript ID and 3. Exon ID with increasing character length, so that merged IDs are coming last
  id_order <- vector() 
  # 1. load DEA gene results, save only necessary information for the gene of interest, change column names and save order of IDs
  load(paste0(results_path, "/1.1_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis.RData"))
  gene_expr <- top_hits[top_hits$`Gene Symbol` == gene, ][, c("Ensembl Gene ID", "LogFC", "95% Confidence Interval, lower bound", "95% Confidence Interval, upper bound", "FDR estimate")]
  colnames(gene_expr) <- c("ID", "LogFC", "CI_lower", "CI_upper", "FDR")
  id_order <- c(id_order, gene_expr[order(nchar(gene_expr$ID)), ]$ID)
  # 2. load DEA transcript results (for normal model, including all transcripts) and perform same steps as above
  load(paste0(results_path, "/2.1_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis.RData"))
  transcript_expr <- top_hits[top_hits$`Gene Symbol` == gene, ][, c("Ensembl Transcript ID", "LogFC", "95% Confidence Interval, lower bound", "95% Confidence Interval, upper bound", "FDR estimate")]
  # change all FDRs to 1 (as we only want to keep the ones with the new FDRs)
  transcript_expr$`FDR estimate` <- 1
  colnames(transcript_expr) <- c("ID", "LogFC", "CI_lower", "CI_upper", "FDR")
  id_order <- c(id_order, transcript_expr[order(nchar(transcript_expr$ID)), ]$ID)
  # 3. load DEA exon results (same steps as for transcripts above)
  load(paste0(results_path, "/3.1_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis.RData"))
  exon_expr <- top_hits[top_hits$`Gene Symbol` == gene, ][, c("Ensembl Exon ID", "LogFC", "95% Confidence Interval, lower bound", "95% Confidence Interval, upper bound", "FDR estimate")]
  exon_expr$`FDR estimate` <- 1
  colnames(exon_expr) <- c("ID", "LogFC", "CI_lower", "CI_upper", "FDR")
  id_order <- c(id_order, exon_expr[order(nchar(exon_expr$ID)), ]$ID)
  # merge all three datasets using rbind
  all <- rbind(gene_expr, transcript_expr, exon_expr)
  # change ID column to factor and refactor using the saved order
  all$ID <- as.factor(all$ID)
  all$ID <- factor(all$ID, levels = rev(id_order))
  
  # get number of filtered/total transcripts and exons
  filtered_transcripts <- length(unique(separate_rows(transcript_expr, "ID", sep = "\\|")$ID))
  total_transcripts <- length(unique(gencode[gencode$gene_name == gene & gencode$type == "transcript", ]$transcript_id))
  filtered_exons <- length(unique(separate_rows(exon_expr, "ID", sep = "\\|")$ID))
  total_exons <- length(unique(gencode[gencode$gene_name == gene & gencode$type == "exon", ]$exon_id))
  
  # update the "two" FDRs (one transcript, one exon):
  # load DEA transcript results for new p-value/FDR correction
  load(paste0(results_path, "/2.4_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.RData"))
  transcript_expr <- top_hits[top_hits$`Gene Symbol` == gene, ][, c("Ensembl Transcript ID", "FDR estimate")]
  # change FDR for the given transcript ID in the merged dataset
  all[all$ID == transcript_expr$`Ensembl Transcript ID`, "FDR"] <- transcript_expr$`FDR estimate`
  # load DEA exon results for new p-value/FDR correction
  load(paste0(results_path, "/3.4_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.RData"))
  exon_expr <- top_hits[top_hits$`Gene Symbol` == gene, ][, c("Ensembl Exon ID", "FDR estimate")]
  # change FDR for the given exon ID in the merged dataset
  all[all$ID == exon_expr$`Ensembl Exon ID`, "FDR"] <- exon_expr$`FDR estimate`

  # generate Plot
  g <- ggplot(all, aes(x = ID, y = LogFC, ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 22) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, size = 2), axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) +
  geom_pointrange() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[3]) +
  geom_text(label = ifelse(all$FDR < 1, paste0("FDR = ", round(all$FDR, 2)), ""), aes(hjust = -0.5, vjust = -0.2), colour = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[3]) +
  coord_flip() +
  ggtitle(paste0(gene_expr$ID, " (", gene, ")\n# filtered transcripts: ", (total_transcripts - filtered_transcripts), "; # total transcripts: ", total_transcripts, "\n# filtered exons: ", (total_exons - filtered_exons), "; # total exons: ", total_exons)) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab(bquote("Log"["2"]*"(Fold Change)"))
  # save plot
  ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(outpath, "/4_forest_plot_for_gene_", gene, ".pdf"), width = 12.5, height = 5.75)
  g
}
```

# Colors

We also will set the color for the three genetic level (gene, transcript and exon) using the viridis package. 
```{r}
col_con <- viridis(1000, option = "D", begin = 0.15, end = 0.9)
col_dis <- viridis(3, option = "D", begin = 0.15, end = 0.9)
col_gdegene <- col_dis[1]  # purple
col_tdegene <- col_dis[2]  # turquoise
col_edegene <- col_dis[3]  # light green
```

## GENCODE

And GENCODE to get the original number of genes, transcripts and exons. We will filter it exactly as in the preprocessing step (only protein-coding genes from the HAVANA source).
```{r}
gencode <- import.gff("/lustre/groups/ccm01/datasets/2018_MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/annotation_files/gencode.v19.annotation.gtf", format = "gtf")
```

# DEA Genes

## Diagnosis model

### Load Data

First, we need to load the dataset (.RData file) generated in the differential expression analysis (DEA) for genes differentially expressed for the diagnosis (cases vs. controls).
```{r}
# load RData file
load(paste0(results_path, "/1.1_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis.RData"))
```

### Volcano Plot

Generate a volcano plot (y-axis: -log10 of p-values, x-axis: log2FC) for all hits. As volcano plots include many points and therefore need a long time to open/load, we will not include them in the generated .pdf file of this script, but save them into their own files.
```{r}
# generate volcano plot
GenerateVolcanoPlot(fit, variable = "DxCASE", cols = col_gdegene, file = "1.1_volcano_plot_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis.pdf")
```

### Barplot

And we generate a barplot including all significantly differentially expressed genes for each covariate of the model (corrected for all the other covariates in the model).
```{r, echo = F}
# generate vertical barplot
limma_res_gene <- GenerateVerticalBarplotOfDiffExprHits(design, fit, from = 4, to = 3, plot_name = "1.1_barplot_significant_DEA_hits_genes.pdf")
ggplot(limma_res_gene, aes(y = sort.limma_res_padj_0.1..decreasing...T., x = reorder(row.names(limma_res_gene), sort.limma_res_padj_0.1..decreasing...T.))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_classic(base_size = 22) +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 22), panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, size = 2), axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) +
    ylab("# significant hits") +
    xlab("") +
    geom_text(size = 7, aes(label = sort.limma_res_padj_0.1..decreasing...T.), nudge_y = 120, colour = "dimgray") + 
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.01))
rm(design, fit)
```

## Sex * Diagnosis interaction model

### Load Data

Load the dataset generated in the DEA for genes differentially expressed for the diagnosis with sex*diagnosis interaction.
```{r}
# load RData file
load(paste0(results_path, "/1.2_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis_with_sex_dx_interaction.RData"))
sex_diagnosis_int_gene <- top_hits[top_hits$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, ]
```

### Volcano Plot

Generate a volcano plot (y-axis: -log10 of p-values, x-axis: log2FC) for all hits.
```{r}
# volcano plot
GenerateVolcanoPlot(fit, variable = "DxCASE", cols = col_gdegene, file = "1.2_volcano_plot_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis_with_sex_dx_interaction.pdf")
rm(design, fit)
```

### Boxplot

For the TRIM10 hit, we will plot the residuals of sex vs. diagnosis as this gene infers a difference between these two covariates. To generate the TRIM10 boxplot we will use the results from the normal model to see the difference between the two sexes.
```{r, echo = F}
# load data
load(paste0(results_path, "/1.1_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis.RData"))
# generate boxplot with case vs control for male and female samples of the hit gene (TRIM10)
trim10 <- res[rownames(res) == "ENSG00000204613.6", ]
trim10 <- t(t(as.data.frame(trim10)))
trim10 <- merge(trim10, pData(gene_summaries)[, c("ShortName", "Dx", "Sex")], by.x = "row.names", by.y = "ShortName", all.x = T)
trim10$DxSex <- paste0(trim10$Dx, trim10$Sex)
g <- ggplot(trim10, aes(Sex, trim10, fill = Dx)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Female", "Male")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 22) + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 22), axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1), panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, size = 2), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray", col_gdegene), labels = c("Controls", "Cases")) + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) + 
  ggtitle("TRIM10") +
  ylab("Gene expression") + 
  xlab("Sex") + 
  labs(fill = "Diagnosis")
ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(outpath, "/1.2_boxplot_TRIM10_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis_with_sex_dx_interaction.pdf"), width = 7, height = 6)
g
# p-value females
females <- trim10[trim10$Sex == "F",]
case <- females[females$Dx == "CASE",]
control <- females[females$Dx == "CTL",]
t.test(case$trim10, control$trim10) # p-value = 0.01022
# p-value males
males <- trim10[trim10$Sex == "M",]
case <- males[males$Dx == "CASE",]
control <- males[males$Dx == "CTL",]
t.test(case$trim10, control$trim10) # p-value = 0.05302
# remove unnecessary data
rm(design, fit, res, trim10, females, males, case, control, g)
```

## PRS with normal model

We did not have hits for any polygenic risk score (different GWAS), so we will not plot anything here. But we have hits on the transcript and exon level using the new FDR calculation and will generate some barplots there.

## New FDR model

As we have a lot of transcripts (N = 100,750), we are not getting any hits as the FDR correction overcorrects. Therefore, we picked for each gene the transcript with the lowest p-value and rerun the DEA (FDR calculation) only for the gene based transcripts, resulting in tDEGene hits. This procedure we call here: new FDR model.

### Load data

Load the tDEGene dataset.
```{r}
# load RData file
load(paste0(results_path, "/2.4_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.RData"))
```

### Volcano plot 

Generate a volcano plot.
```{r}
# volcano plot
GenerateVolcanoPlot(fit, variable = "DxCASE", cols = col_tdegene, file = "2.4_volcano_plot_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf")
```

### Barplot of tDEGenes (all covariates)

Get tDEGenes for each covariate (corrected for all the other covariates).
```{r, echo = F}

limma_res_transcript_new <- GenerateVerticalBarplotOfDiffExprHits(design, fit, from = 5, to = 4, plot_name = "2.4_barplot_significant_DEA_hits_transcripts_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf")
ggplot(limma_res_transcript_new, aes(y = sort.limma_res_padj_0.1..decreasing...T., x = reorder(row.names(limma_res_transcript_new), sort.limma_res_padj_0.1..decreasing...T.))) +

    ylab("# significant hits") +
```

### Heatmap of tDEGenes (diagnosis)

Now, we generate some plots for the six found tDEGenes for diagnosis. First, we will plot a heatmap of the six tDEGenes.
```{r, echo = F}
# get only top hits (6 tDEGenes)
top_hits <- top_hits[top_hits$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, ]
# generate heatmap of hits
anno <- pData(transcript_summaries)[, c("Age", "PMI", "RIN", "Sex", "Suicide", "Dx", "ShortName")]
rownames(anno) <- anno$ShortName
# generate Age bins (from 18-35, 35-52, 52-70, 70-87)
anno$Age <- cut(anno$Age, breaks = c(18, 35, 52, 70, 88), right = FALSE, labels = c("18-35", "35-52", "52-70", "70-88"))
# generate PMI bins
anno$PMI <- cut(anno$PMI, breaks = c(8, 26, 44, 62, 79), right = FALSE, labels = c("8-26", "26-44", "44-62", "62-79"))
# generate RIN bins
anno$RIN <- cut(anno$RIN, breaks = c(6, 7, 8, 9, 10), right = FALSE, labels = c("6-7", "7-8", "8-9", "9-10"))
anno$ShortName <- NULL
# Specify annotation colors
annotation_colors = list(Sex = c("M" = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[10], "F" = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[2]),
                         Dx = c("CTL" = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[9], "CASE" = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[3]),
                         Suicide = c("N" = brewer.pal(11, "PuOr")[9], "Y" = brewer.pal(11, "PuOr")[3]),
                         RIN = c("6-7" = brewer.pal(9, "Oranges")[3], "7-8" = brewer.pal(9, "Oranges")[5], "8-9" = brewer.pal(9, "Oranges")[7], "9-10" = brewer.pal(9, "Oranges")[9]),
                         Age = c("18-35" = brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[3], "35-52" = brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[5], "52-70" = brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[7], "70-88" = brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[9]),
                         PMI = c("8-26" = brewer.pal(9, "Purples")[3], "26-44" = brewer.pal(9, "Purples")[5], "44-62" = brewer.pal(9, "Purples")[7], "62-79" = brewer.pal(9, "Purples")[9]))
# change Transcript IDs with Gene Symbols
tdegenes_exprs <- exprs(transcript_summaries)[top_hits$`Ensembl Transcript ID`, ]
transcript_to_symbol <- fData(transcript_summaries)[fData(transcript_summaries)$transcript_id %in% row.names(tdegenes_exprs), c("transcript_id", "gene_name")]
tdegenes_exprs <- merge(tdegenes_exprs, transcript_to_symbol, by.x = "row.names", by.y = "transcript_id", all.x = T)
row.names(tdegenes_exprs) <- tdegenes_exprs$gene_name
tdegenes_exprs <- tdegenes_exprs[, -c(1, length(tdegenes_exprs))]
# generate heatmaps
pheatmap(tdegenes_exprs, scale = "row", annotation_col = anno, annotation_colors = annotation_colors, show_colnames = F, color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")))(100))
dev.off()
pheatmap(tdegenes_exprs, scale = "row", annotation_col = anno, annotation_colors = annotation_colors, show_colnames = F, color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")))(100), filename = paste0(outpath, "/2.4_heatmap_significant_DEA_hits_transcripts_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf")) # clustering_method = "ward.D2"
rm(anno, annotation_colors, tdegenes_exprs, transcript_to_symbol)
```

### Barplot of up/down-regulated tDEGenes (diagnosis)

Then, we plot the up and down regulated genes into one barplot with the two variables mirrored on the x-axis.
```{r, echo = F}
logfc <- as.data.frame(table(top_hits$LogFC))
logfc$group <- "Upregulated"
logfc[as.numeric(as.character(logfc$Var1)) < 0, "group"] <- "Downregulated"
logfc[as.numeric(as.character(logfc$Var1)) < 0, "Freq"] <- -1
logfc$Var1 <- abs(round(as.numeric(as.character(logfc$Var1)), 2))
logfc$logfc <- 2^logfc$Var1
logfc$linearFC <- sapply(logfc$logfc, function(x) {if(as.double(as.character(x)) >= 1 || is.na(x)){x} else {-1/x}})
# generate barplot
g <- ggplot(logfc, aes(x = linearFC, y = Freq, fill = group)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "identity", show.legend = F, orientation = logfc$Freq) + 
  xlab("linear fold change") +
  ylab("# tDEGenes (FDR < 10%)") +
  xlim(1, 1.5) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 22) +
  theme(axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(colour = "black"), panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, size = 2), axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"), axis.line.y.left = element_line(colour = "black"), axis.ticks.length = unit(.15, "cm"), axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black")) + 
  annotate("text", x = 1.4, y = 1.3, label = paste0("No. of genes upregulated: ", length(logfc[logfc$group == "Upregulated", "group"])), size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.4, y = -1.3, label = paste0("No. of genes downregulated: ", length(logfc[logfc$group == "Downregulated", "group"])), size = 4) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[c(9, 3)])
ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(outpath, "/2.4_barplot_up_down_regulated_significant_DEA_hits_transcripts_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf"), width = 5.43, height = 3.45, units = "in")
g
rm(logfc, g)
```

### Violin plots of tDEGenes (diagnosis)

Now, we generate violin plots for all gene hits.
```{r, echo = F}
for (hit in top_hits$`Ensembl Transcript ID`) {
  name <- top_hits[top_hits$`Ensembl Transcript ID` == hit, "Gene Symbol"]
  # get exprs of top hit

    labs(title = paste0(hit, ": ", top_hits[top_hits$`Ensembl Transcript ID` == hit, "Gene Symbol"]), x = element_blank(), y = "Expression values") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Controls", "Cases")) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray", col_tdegene), guide = FALSE, name = "", labels = c("Controls", "Cases"))
  ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(outpath, "/2.4_violinplot_significant_DEA_hits_transcripts_new_pvalue_and_fdr_", top_hits[top_hits$`Ensembl Transcript ID` == hit, "Gene Symbol"],".pdf"), width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")
  g
}
rm(design, fit, name, data, top_hits, g)
```

### Boxplot

#### TRIM10
For the TRIM10 hit, we will plot the residuals of sex vs. diagnosis as this gene infers a difference between these two covariates. To generate the TRIM10 boxplot we will use the results from the normal model and the transcript ENST00000376704.3|ENST00000449742.2 of the gene to see the difference between the two sexes.
```{r, echo = F}
# load data
load(paste0(results_path, "/2.4_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.RData"))
# generate boxplot with case vs control for male and female samples of the hit gene (TRIM10)
trim10 <- res[rownames(res) == "ENST00000376704.3|ENST00000449742.2", ]
trim10 <- t(t(as.data.frame(trim10)))
trim10 <- merge(trim10, pData(transcript_summaries)[, c("ShortName", "Dx", "Sex")], by.x = "row.names", by.y = "ShortName", all.x = T)
trim10$DxSex <- paste0(trim10$Dx, trim10$Sex)
g <- ggplot(trim10, aes(Sex, trim10, fill = Dx)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Female", "Male")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 22) + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 22), axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1), panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, size = 2), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray", col_gdegene), labels = c("Controls", "Cases")) + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) + 
  ggtitle("TRIM10") +
  ylab("Gene expression") + 
  xlab("Sex") + 
  labs(fill = "Diagnosis")
ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(outpath, "/2.4_boxplot_TRIM10__diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis_with_sex_dx_interaction_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf"), width = 7, height = 6)
g
# p-value females
females <- trim10[trim10$Sex == "F",]
case <- females[females$Dx == "CASE",]
control <- females[females$Dx == "CTL",]
t.test(case$trim10, control$trim10) # p-value = 0.01022
# p-value males
males <- trim10[trim10$Sex == "M",]
case <- males[males$Dx == "CASE",]
control <- males[males$Dx == "CTL",]
t.test(case$trim10, control$trim10) # p-value = 0.05302
# remove unnecessary data
rm(design, fit, trim10, females, males, case, control, g)
```

## PRS with new FDR model

We will generate a barplot of the number of hits, we get using the different calculated polygenic risk scores. 

### Load datasets

We need to load all PRS transcript DEA hits and save only the number of found hits (FDR < 10% and FDR < 5%) into a table.
```{r, echo = F}
prs_all <- c("ADHD-2019", "ASD-2019", "BIP-2019", "BMI-2015", "CAD-2017", "CDG1-2013", "CDG2-2019", "EA-2018", "HE-2014", "IN-2018", "MDD1-2012", "MDD2-2018", "MDD3-2019", "SCZ2-2014", "T2D-2017", "SCZ3-2020")
prs_transcripts <- data.frame("PRS" = character(), "FDR_0.1" = numeric(), "FDR_0.05" = numeric())
count = 1
for (p in prs_all) {
  prs <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/2.5.", count, "_diff_expr_transcripts_for_", p, "_PRS_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), select = c("Gene Symbol", "FDR estimate"), stringsAsFactors = F)
  fdr10 <- length(unique(prs[prs$`FDR estimate` < 0.10, ]$`Gene Symbol`))
  fdr5 <- length(unique(prs[prs$`FDR estimate` < 0.05, ]$`Gene Symbol`))
  new_row <- data.frame("PRS" = p, "FDR_0.1" = fdr10, "FDR_0.05" = fdr5)
  prs_transcripts <- rbind(prs_transcripts, new_row)
  count = count + 1
}
```

### Barplot

Now, we can generate a barplot for all the PRS based DEA hits on transcript level, also called transcript expression quantitative trait score (teQTS). 
```{r, echo = F}
# first we need to get the data into the right format
plot_prs <- reshape2::melt(prs_transcripts, id.vars = "PRS")
g <- ggplot(data = plot_prs, aes(x = PRS, y = value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_bar(position = "identity", stat = "identity") + 
  theme_classic(base_size = 22) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15), panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, size = 2), axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"), legend.position = c(0.07, 0.88), legend.box.background = element_rect(colour = "grey"), legend.title = element_blank()) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Number of transcript eQTS") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[c(9, 3)], labels = c("FDR < 0.01", "FDR < 0.05")) +
  geom_text(label = plot_prs$value)
ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(outpath, "/2.5_barplot_ALL_PRS_transcript_eQTS_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf"))
g
```

### Forest plot 
Forest plot showing the log2FC range and median (dot) of the 2,223 exon-level differentially expressed gene hits for all three levels. The 2,223 genes exhibit a larger magnitude of changes on the exon-level (median abs. log2FC = 0.23, range of -0.69 to 0.75) compared to the two other levels (transcript median abs. log2FC = 0.11, range of -0.47 to 0.55, and gene median abs. log2FC = 0.047, range of -0.38 to 0.51).
```{r}
# gDEGenes
load(paste0(results_path, "/1.1_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis.RData"))
gDEGene_hits <- topTable(fit, coef = "DxCASE", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
gDEGene_hits <- gDEGene_hits[gDEGene_hits$gene_id %in% eDEGene_hits$gene_id, ]
#tDEGenes
load(paste0(results_path, "/2.4_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.RData"))
tDEGene_hits <- topTable(fit, coef = "DxCASE", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
tDEGene_hits <- unique(as.data.frame(separate_rows(tDEGene_hits, `gene_id`, sep = "\\|")))  # separate if gene IDs were merged
tDEGene_hits <- tDEGene_hits[tDEGene_hits$gene_id %in% eDEGene_hits$gene_id, ]
# eDEGenes
load(paste0(results_path, "/3.4_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.RData"))
eDEGene_hits <- topTable(fit, coef = "DxCASE", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
eDEGene_hits <- eDEGene_hits[eDEGene_hits$adj.P.Val < 0.1, ]
eDEGene_hits <- unique(as.data.frame(separate_rows(eDEGene_hits, `gene_id`, sep = "\\|")))  # separate if gene IDs were merged
```

Table showing the log2 fold change (log2FC) range and the median of the absolute log2FC of the gene-, transcript- and exon-level differentially expressed gene (DEGene) hits:

| Differentially expressed genes (DEGenes) | Min of log2FC | Max of log2FC | Median of abs log2FC |
|------|------|------|------|
| gDEGenes | `r min(gDEGene_hits$logFC)` | `r round(max(gDEGene_hits$logFC), 2)` | `r round(median(abs(gDEGene_hits$logFC)), 2)` |
| tDEGenes | `r min(tDEGene_hits$logFC)` | `r round(max(tDEGene_hits$logFC), 2)` | `r round(median(abs(tDEGene_hits$logFC)), 2)` |
| eDEGenes | `r min(eDEGene_hits$logFC)` | `r round(max(eDEGene_hits$logFC), 2)` | `r round(median(abs(eDEGene_hits$logFC)), 2)` |

Finally, we can generate the forest plot:
```{r, echo = F}
# Create a data frame with min and max log2FC and median of the absolute log2FC for gene-, transcript- and exon-level DEGenes
a <- c("Gene", "Transcript", "Exon")
b <- c(min(gDEGene_hits$logFC), min(tDEGene_hits$logFC), min(eDEGene_hits$logFC))
c <- c(max(gDEGene_hits$logFC), max(tDEGene_hits$logFC), max(eDEGene_hits$logFC))
d <- c(median(abs(gDEGene_hits$logFC)), median(abs(tDEGene_hits$logFC)), median(abs(eDEGene_hits$logFC)))
# Join the variables to create a data frame
all <- data.frame(a, b, c, d)
colnames(all) <- c("Type", "mini", "maxi", "medi")
# change order of Type
all$Type <- factor(all$Type, levels = c("Exon", "Transcript", "Gene"))

g <- ggplot(all, aes(x = Type, y = medi, ymin = mini, ymax = maxi, color = Type)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), text = element_text(size = 18), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16), axis.line = element_line(size = 1, linetype = "solid")) +
  geom_errorbar(size = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab(bquote("median abs. log"["2"]*"FC")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Gene" = col_gdegene, "Transcript" = col_tdegene, "Exon" = col_edegene))
# save plot
ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(outpath, "/4_forest_plot_log2fc_for_gene_transcript_exon_level_of_2223_eDEGene_hits.pdf"), width = 12.5, height = 5.75)
g
```

### Heatmap of eDEGenes (diagnosis)

First, we will plot a heatmap of the 2223 eDEGenes.
```{r, echo = F}
# get only top hits (2223 eDEGenes)
top_hits <- top_hits[top_hits$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, ]
# ǵenerate heatmap of hits
anno <- pData(exon_summaries)[, c("Age", "PMI", "RIN", "Sex", "Suicide", "Dx", "ShortName")]
rownames(anno) <- anno$ShortName
anno$ShortName <- NULL
# generate Age bins (from 18-35, 35-52, 52-70, 70-87)
anno$Age <- cut(anno$Age, breaks = c(18, 35, 52, 70, 88), right = FALSE, labels = c("18-35", "35-52", "52-70", "70-88"))
# generate PMI bins
anno$PMI <- cut(anno$PMI, breaks = c(8, 26, 44, 62, 79), right = FALSE, labels = c("8-26", "26-44", "44-62", "62-79"))
# generate RIN bins
anno$RIN <- cut(anno$RIN, breaks = c(6, 7, 8, 9, 10), right = FALSE, labels = c("6-7", "7-8", "8-9", "9-10"))
# Specify annotation colors
annotation_colors = list(Sex = c("M" = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[10], "F" = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[2]),
                         Dx = c("CTL" = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[9], "CASE" = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[3]),
                         Suicide = c("N" = brewer.pal(11, "PuOr")[9], "Y" = brewer.pal(11, "PuOr")[3]),
                         RIN = c("6-7" = brewer.pal(9, "Oranges")[3], "7-8" = brewer.pal(9, "Oranges")[5], "8-9" = brewer.pal(9, "Oranges")[7], "9-10" = brewer.pal(9, "Oranges")[9]),
                         Age = c("18-35" = brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[3], "35-52" = brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[5], "52-70" = brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[7], "70-88" = brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[9]),
                         PMI = c("8-26" = brewer.pal(9, "Purples")[3], "26-44" = brewer.pal(9, "Purples")[5], "44-62" = brewer.pal(9, "Purples")[7], "62-79" = brewer.pal(9, "Purples")[9]))
# change Exon IDs with Gene Symbols
edegenes_exprs <- as.data.frame(exprs(exon_summaries)[top_hits$`Ensembl Exon ID`, ])
edegenes_exprs$exon_id <- row.names(exprs(exon_summaries)[top_hits$`Ensembl Exon ID`, ])
exon_to_symbol <- fData(exon_summaries)[fData(exon_summaries)$exon_id %in% edegenes_exprs$exon_id, c("exon_id", "gene_name")]
# remove all multiple gene symbols (mostly duplicated)
exon_to_symbol$gene_name <- sapply(exon_to_symbol$gene_name, function(x) strsplit(x, "\\|")[[1]][1])
edegenes_exprs <- plyr::join(edegenes_exprs, exon_to_symbol)
edegenes_exprs <- edegenes_exprs[, -c(1, length(edegenes_exprs) - 1)]
# generate plot
pheatmap(edegenes_exprs[, -c(length(edegenes_exprs))], scale = "row", annotation_col = anno, annotation_colors = annotation_colors, show_colnames = F, show_rownames = F, color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")))(100))
dev.off()
pheatmap(edegenes_exprs[, -c(length(edegenes_exprs))], scale = "row", annotation_col = anno, annotation_colors = annotation_colors, labels_col = edegenes_exprs$gene_name, show_colnames = F, show_rownames = F, color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")))(100), filename = paste0(outpath, "/3.4_heatmap_significant_DEA_hits_exons_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf"))
rm(anno, annotation_colors, edegenes_exprs, exon_to_symbol)
```

### Barplot of up/down-regulated tDEGenes (diagnosis)

Then, we plot the up and down regulated genes into one barplot with the two variables mirrored on the x-axis.
```{r, echo = F}
logfc <- as.data.frame(table(top_hits$LogFC))
logfc$group <- "Upregulated"
logfc[as.numeric(as.character(logfc$Var1)) < 0, "group"] <- "Downregulated"
logfc[as.numeric(as.character(logfc$Var1)) < 0, "Freq"] <- -1
logfc$Var1 <- abs(round(as.numeric(as.character(logfc$Var1)), 2))
logfc$logfc <- 2^logfc$Var1
logfc$linearFC <- sapply(logfc$logfc, function(x) {if(as.double(as.character(x)) >= 1 || is.na(x)){x} else {-1/x}})
min(logfc$linearFC)
max(logfc$linearFC)
mean(logfc$linearFC)
g <- ggplot(logfc, aes(x = linearFC, y = Freq, fill = group)) + 
  geom_histogram(stat = "identity", show.legend = FALSE, orientation = logfc$Freq) + 
  xlab("Linear fold change") +
  ylab("# tDEGenes (FDR < 10%)") +
  xlim(1, 1.8) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 22) +
  theme(axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(colour = "black"), axis.line.y.left = element_line(colour = "black"), axis.ticks.length = unit(.15, "cm"), panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, size = 2), axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black")) + 
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 30, label = paste0("No. of genes upregulated: ", length(logfc[logfc$group == "Upregulated", "group"])), size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = -30, label = paste0("No. of genes downregulated: ", length(logfc[logfc$group == "Downregulated", "group"])), size = 4) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[c(9, 3)])
g
ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(outpath, "/3.4_barplot_up_down_regulated_significant_DEA_hits_exons_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf"), width = 5.43, height = 3.45, units = "in")
rm(logfc, g)
```

### Violin plots of eDEGenes (diagnosis)

Now, we generate violin plots for the top six eDEGene hits.
```{r, echo = F}
for (hit in top_hits$`Ensembl Exon ID`[1:6]) {
  name <- top_hits[top_hits$`Ensembl Exon ID` == hit, "Gene Symbol"]
  # get exprs of top hit
  data <- as.data.frame(exprs(exon_summaries)[hit, ])
  colnames(data) <- "expression"
  data <- merge(data, pData(exon_summaries)[, c("ShortName", "Dx")], by.x = "row.names", by.y = "ShortName")

    geom_violin() + 
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 22) +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 20), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, size = 2), axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) +
    labs(title = paste0(hit, ":", top_hits[top_hits$`Ensembl Exon ID` == hit, "Gene Symbol"]), x = element_blank(), y = "Expression values") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Controls", "Cases")) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[c(9, 3)], guide = FALSE, name = "", labels = c("Controls", "Cases"))
  ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(outpath, "/3.4_violinplot_significant_DEA_hits_exons_new_pvalue_and_fdr_", top_hits[top_hits$`Ensembl Exon ID` == hit, "Gene Symbol"],".pdf"), width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")
  g
}
rm(name, data)
```

### Boxplots

#### TRIM10

For the TRIM10 hit, we will plot the residuals of sex vs. diagnosis as this gene infers a difference between these two covariates. To generate the TRIM10 boxplot we will use the results from the normal model and the exon ENSE00001889834.1 of the gene to see the difference between the two sexes.
```{r, echo = F}
# load data
load(paste0(results_path, "/3.4_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.RData"))
# generate boxplot with case vs control for male and female samples of the hit gene (TRIM10)
trim10 <- res[rownames(res) == "ENSE00001889834.1", ]
trim10 <- t(t(as.data.frame(trim10)))
trim10 <- merge(trim10, pData(exon_summaries)[, c("ShortName", "Dx", "Sex")], by.x = "row.names", by.y = "ShortName", all.x = T)
trim10$DxSex <- paste0(trim10$Dx, trim10$Sex)
g <- ggplot(trim10, aes(Sex, trim10, fill = Dx)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Female", "Male")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 22) + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 22), axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1), panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, size = 2), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray", col_gdegene), labels = c("Controls", "Cases")) + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) + 
  ggtitle("TRIM10") +
  ylab("Gene expression") + 
  xlab("Sex") + 
  labs(fill = "Diagnosis")
ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(outpath, "/3.4_boxplot_TRIM10__diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis_with_sex_dx_interaction_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf"), width = 7, height = 6)
g
# p-value females
females <- trim10[trim10$Sex == "F",]
case <- females[females$Dx == "CASE",]
control <- females[females$Dx == "CTL",]
t.test(case$trim10, control$trim10) # p-value = 0.02183
# p-value males

case <- males[males$Dx == "CASE",]
control <- males[males$Dx == "CTL",]
t.test(case$trim10, control$trim10) # p-value = 0.1008
# remove unnecessary data
rm(design, fit, trim10, females, males, case, control, g)
```

## PRS with new FDR model

We will generate a barplot of the number of hits, we get using the different calculated polygenic risk scores. And we will combine the PRS DEGenes based on transcript and exon level with FDR < 10% in one plot. 

### Load datasets

We need to load all PRS exon DEA hits and save only the number of found hits (FDR < 10% and FDR < 5%) into a table.
```{r, echo = F}
prs_all <- c("ADHD-2019", "ASD-2019", "BIP-2019", "BIP-2021", "BMI-2015", "CAD-2017", "CDG1-2013", "CDG2-2019", "EA-2018", "HE-2014", "IN-2018", "MDD1-2012", "MDD2-2018", "MDD3-2019", "SCZ2-2014", "SCZ3-2020", "SCZ3-2022", "T2D-2017")
prs_exons <- data.frame("PRS" = character(), "FDR_0.1" = numeric(), "FDR_0.05" = numeric())
count = 1
for (p in prs_all) {
  prs <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/3.5.", count, "_diff_expr_exons_for_", p, "_PRS_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), select = c("Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol", "FDR estimate"), stringsAsFactors = F)
  fdr10 <- length(unique(prs[prs$`FDR estimate` < 0.10, ]$`Ensembl Gene ID`))
  fdr5 <- length(unique(prs[prs$`FDR estimate` < 0.05, ]$`Ensembl Gene ID`))
  new_row <- data.frame("PRS" = p, "FDR_0.1" = fdr10, "FDR_0.05" = fdr5)
  prs_exons <- rbind(prs_exons, new_row)
  count = count + 1
}
```

### Barplot

Now, we can generate a barplot for all the PRS based DEA hits on exon level, also called exon expression quantitative trait score (eeQTS). 
```{r, echo = F}
# first we need to get the data into the right format
plot_prs <- reshape2::melt(prs_exons, id.vars = "PRS")
g <- ggplot(data = plot_prs, aes(x = PRS, y = value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_bar(position = "identity", stat = "identity") + 
  theme_classic(base_size = 22) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 22), legend.position = c(0.07, 0.88), legend.box.background = element_rect(colour = "grey"), legend.title = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, size = 2), axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Number of exon eQTS") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[c(9, 3)], labels = c("FDR < 0.01", "FDR < 0.05")) +
  geom_text(label = plot_prs$value)
ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(outpath, "/3.5_barplot_ALL_PRS_exon_eQTS_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf"))
g
```

Now, we combine Transcript and Exon hits for FDR < 10% in one plot:

### Upset Plot

Upset plot (like VENN) to compare the GWAS DEGene hits (eQTS) with each other:
```{r}
# load data
prs_exons <- list()
count = 1
for (p in prs_all) {
  prs <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/3.5.", count, "_diff_expr_exons_for_", p, "_PRS_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), select = c("Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol", "FDR estimate"), stringsAsFactors = F)
  prs_exons[[length(prs_exons) + 1]] <- list(unique(prs[prs$`FDR estimate` < 0.10, ]$`Ensembl Gene ID`))
  count = count + 1
}
names(prs_exons) <- prs_all

eqts_genes <- list("ADHD-2019" = unlist(prs_exons$`ADHD-2019`), "BIP-2019" = unlist(prs_exons$`BIP-2019`), "SCZ2-2014" = unlist(prs_exons$`SCZ2-2014`), "CDG2-2019" = unlist(prs_exons$`CDG2-2019`), "MDD2-2018" = unlist(prs_exons$`MDD2-2018`), "MDD3_2019" = unlist(prs_exons$`MDD3-2019`))
pdf(paste0(outpath, "/4_upset_plot__ADHD_BIP_CDG2_MDD2_MDD3_SCZ2_exons_eQTS_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf"), width = 14, height = 7, onefile = F)
upset(fromList(eqts_genes), 
      sets = c("ADHD-2019", "BIP-2019", "CDG2-2019", "MDD2-2018", "MDD3_2019", "SCZ2-2014"),
      nsets = 6, 
      mainbar.y.label = "# genes", 
      text.scale = 2, 
      keep.order = F)
dev.off()

# get upregulated genes per exon eQT-Score
adhd <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/3.5.1_diff_expr_exons_for_ADHD-2019_PRS_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), select = c("Ensembl Gene ID", "T-statistic"), stringsAsFactors = F)
bd <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/3.5.3_diff_expr_exons_for_BIP-2019_PRS_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), select = c("Ensembl Gene ID", "T-statistic"), stringsAsFactors = F)
scz <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/3.5.14_diff_expr_exons_for_SCZ2-2014_PRS_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), select = c("Ensembl Gene ID", "T-statistic"), stringsAsFactors = F)
cdg <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/3.5.7_diff_expr_exons_for_CDG2-2019_PRS_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), select = c("Ensembl Gene ID", "T-statistic"), stringsAsFactors = F)
mdd <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/3.5.13_diff_expr_exons_for_MDD3-2019_PRS_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), select = c("Ensembl Gene ID", "T-statistic"), stringsAsFactors = F)

get_upregulated_genes <- function(prs, gwas){
  upreg <- cbind(unlist(prs_exons[gwas]), FALSE)
  for(gene in upreg[, 1]) {
    if(prs[prs$`Ensembl Gene ID` == gene, ]$`T-statistic`[[1]] > 0){
      upreg[upreg[, 1] == gene, 2] <- TRUE
    }
  }
  return(upreg)
}
upreg_adhd <- get_upregulated_genes(adhd, "ADHD-2019")
upreg_bd <- get_upregulated_genes(bd, "BIP-2019")
upreg_cdg <- get_upregulated_genes(cdg, "CDG2-2019")
upreg_mdd <- get_upregulated_genes(mdd, "MDD3-2019")
upreg_scz <- get_upregulated_genes(scz, "SCZ2-2014")
upreg_all <- list("MDD" = sum(as.logical(upreg_mdd[, 2])), "CDG" = sum(as.logical(upreg_cdg[, 2])), "SCZ" = sum(as.logical(upreg_scz[, 2])), "BD" = sum(as.logical(upreg_bd[, 2])), "ADHD" = sum(as.logical(upreg_adhd[, 2])))

# without MDD2 & CDG
eqts_genes <- list("ADHD" = unlist(prs_exons$`ADHD-2019`), "BD" = unlist(prs_exons$`BIP-2019`), "SCZ" = unlist(prs_exons$`SCZ2-2014`), "MDD" = unlist(prs_exons$`MDD3-2019`))
pdf(paste0(outpath, "/4_upset_plot_ADHD_BD_MDD3_SCZ2_exons_eQTS_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf"), width = 14, height = 7, onefile = F)
upset(fromList(eqts_genes), 
      sets = c("ADHD", "BD", "MDD", "SCZ"),
      nsets = 6, 
      mainbar.y.label = "# genes", 
      text.scale = 2, 
      keep.order = F)
dev.off()
```


# Overlap to GWAS Catalog

Now, we will check, how many of the eDEGenes overlap with the schizophrenia trait (EFO_0000692) in the GWAS Catalog v1.0 (2020-07-14) downloaded on 28th July 2020.
```{r}
# load GWAS Catalog
gwas_cat <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/datasets/2020_GWAS_Catalog/gwas_catalog_v1.0.2-associations_e100_r2020-07-14.tsv", header = T, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F)
gwas_cat <- gwas_cat[grep("EFO_0000692", gwas_cat$MAPPED_TRAIT_URI), ]
gwas_cat_genes <- gwas_cat$SNP_GENE_IDS
gwas_cat_genes <- gwas_cat_genes[gwas_cat_genes != ""]
gwas_cat_genes <- unique(unlist(lapply(gwas_cat_genes, function(x) strsplit(x, ", "))))
print(paste0("GWAS Catalog - number of Schizophrenia related Genes: ", length(gwas_cat_genes)))
# get tDEGene hits (Ensembl gene IDs)
load(paste0(results_path, "/2.4_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.RData"))
tDEGene_hits <- topTable(fit, coef = "DxCASE", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
tDEGene_hits <- tDEGene_hits[tDEGene_hits$adj.P.Val < 0.1, ]
tDEGene_hits <- unique(separate_rows(tDEGene_hits, `gene_id`, sep = "\\|")$gene_id)  # separate if gene IDs were merged
# remove the ending of the Ensembl Gene IDs
eDEGene_hits <- unlist(lapply(eDEGene_hits$gene_id, function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1]))
tDEGene_hits <- unlist(lapply(tDEGene_hits, function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1]))
# get number of overlap to GWAS catalog genes
print(paste0("Overlap tDEGenes to SCZ-GWAScat: ", length(intersect(tDEGene_hits, gwas_cat_genes))))
print(paste0("Overlap eDEGenes to SCZ-GWAScat: ", length(intersect(eDEGene_hits, gwas_cat_genes)), " (", round((length(intersect(eDEGene_hits, gwas_cat_genes)) / length(eDEGene_hits)) * 100, 2), "%)"))
rm(gwas_cat, gwas_cat_genes)
```

# Forest plots

Now, we will plot forest plots, generating a horizontal line from lower to upper 95% confidence interval with mean logFC represented as a dot as well as the FDR for the normal model plotted next to the line. We will mark the transcript and exon with the corrected significant FDR values. A forest plot will be generated for following genes with their transcripts and exons:
1. Three genes only significant at exon level:
- FNDC3A
- C14orf37
- NTN4
2. Three genes, significant at transcript and exon level:
- CNGB1
- CSTB
- DPP4
We generated a function above, so that the plot can be generated easily for other genes as well.

## FNDC3A plot

The first exon hit without a transcript (or gene) hit is the FNDC3A. So, we will plot the expression values of the gene with all its transcripts and exons. Only the exon with the lowest p-value was used in the new FDR calculation and was significant FDR < 0.1, indicating that this gene is important at exon level even if no exon was found significant without recalculating FDR. 

First, we need to get the residuals of the differentially expression data for each level (gene, transcript, exon). 
```{r}
# Gene expression
load(paste0(results_path, "/1.1_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis.RData"))
gene_summaries_res <- gene_summaries
exprs(gene_summaries_res) <- res
rm(design, fit, res, top_hits)
# Transcript expression
load(paste0(results_path, "/2.1_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis.RData"))
transcript_summaries_res <- transcript_summaries
exprs(transcript_summaries_res) <- res
rm(design, fit, res, top_hits)
# Exon expression
load(paste0(results_path, "/3.1_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis.RData"))
exon_summaries_res <- exon_summaries
exprs(exon_summaries_res) <- res
rm(design, fit, res, top_hits)
```

Then, we need to get all the IDs for FNDC3A:
```{r}
# 3.4 Get FNDC3A gene, transcript and exon expressions
# 3.4.1 Get FNDC3A gene expression
fndc3a_id <- fData(gene_summaries_res)[fData(gene_summaries_res)$gene_name == "FNDC3A", "gene_id"]
fndc3a_gene_expr <- as.data.frame(exprs(gene_summaries_res)[fndc3a_id, ])
colnames(fndc3a_gene_expr) <- fndc3a_id

# 3.4.2 Get FNDC3A transcript expression
fndc3a_id <- fData(transcript_summaries_res)[grep("FNDC3A", fData(transcript_summaries_res)$gene_name), "transcript_id"]
fndc3a_transcript_expr <- t(as.data.frame(exprs(transcript_summaries_res)[fndc3a_id, ]))

# 3.4.3 Get FNDC3A exon expression
fndc3a_id <- fData(exon_summaries_res)[grep("FNDC3A", fData(exon_summaries_res)$gene_name), "exon_id"]
fndc3a_exon_expr <- t(as.data.frame(exprs(exon_summaries_res)[fndc3a_id, ]))

# 3.5 Merge datasets
fndc3a <- fndc3a_gene_expr
fndc3a <- merge(fndc3a, fndc3a_transcript_expr, by = 0)
fndc3a <- merge(fndc3a, fndc3a_exon_expr, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = "row.names")
#fndc3a <- merge(fndc3a, pData, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = "row.names")
colnames(fndc3a)[1] <- "SampleID"
dim(fndc3a)  # should be 169 rows (samples)

# 3.6 Form data into right order
fndc3a <- fndc3a[, c("SampleID", "ENSG00000102531.12", "ENST00000378383.1", "ENST00000497644.1", "ENST00000541916.1|ENST00000484074.1", "ENST00000492622.2", "ENST00000398316.3", "ENSE00000682482.1", "ENSE00003553418.1|ENSE00003591878.1", "ENSE00000682481.1", "ENSE00001335285.2", "ENSE00003618072.1|ENSE00003538992.1", "ENSE00001342704.1", "ENSE00001422888.3", "ENSE00003657943.1|ENSE00003595023.1", "ENSE00003647569.1|ENSE00003636520.1", "ENSE00003532194.1|ENSE00001896523.1|ENSE00003662779.1", "ENSE00003537609.1|ENSE00003598917.1", "ENSE00001129140.1", "ENSE00001129131.1", "ENSE00003488149.1|ENSE00003524858.1", "ENSE00003479083.1|ENSE00003595348.1|ENSE00003582104.1", "ENSE00001922094.2", "ENSE00001342700.1", "ENSE00001129122.1", "ENSE00001129152.1", "ENSE00003561019.1|ENSE00003616958.1", "ENSE00000939645.1", "ENSE00001378011.1|ENSE00001934521.1", "ENSE00003676028.1|ENSE00003632112.1", "ENSE00003610694.1|ENSE00003685468.1", "ENSE00003535624.1|ENSE00003689909.1")]
colnames(fndc3a) <- c("SampleID", "FNDC3A", "FNDC3A-001", "FNDC3A-006", "FNDC3A-004", "FNDC3A-003", "FNDC3A-002", "ENSE00000682482.1", "ENSE00003553418.1", "ENSE00000682481.1", "ENSE00001335285.2", "ENSE00003618072.1", "ENSE00001342704.1", "ENSE00001422888.3", "ENSE00003657943.1", "ENSE00003636520.1", "ENSE00003532194.1", "ENSE00003537609.1", "ENSE00001129140.1", "ENSE00001129131.1", "ENSE00003488149.1", "ENSE00003479083.1", "ENSE00001922094.2", "ENSE00001342700.1", "ENSE00001129122.1", "ENSE00001129152.1", "ENSE00003561019.1", "ENSE00000939645.1", "ENSE00001378011.1", "ENSE00003632112.1", "ENSE00003685468.1", "ENSE00003689909.1")

# 3.7 Change FNDC3A data into ggplot long format
fndc3a_plot_data <- reshape2::melt(fndc3a, id.vars = "SampleID", value.name = "Expression", variable.name = "EnsemblID" )
fndc3a_plot_data$Type <- "Exons"
fndc3a_plot_data[as.character(fndc3a_plot_data$EnsemblID) == "FNDC3A", "Type"] <- "Gene"
fndc3a_plot_data[startsWith(as.character(fndc3a_plot_data$EnsemblID), "FNDC3A-"), "Type"] <- "Transcripts"
fndc3a_plot_data$Type <- as.factor(fndc3a_plot_data$Type)
# relevel to gene, transcript, exon order
fndc3a_plot_data$Type <- factor(fndc3a_plot_data$Type, levels = c("Gene", "Transcripts", "Exons"))
# add case/control information
fndc3a_plot_data$SampleType <- "Cases"
controls <-pData(gene_summaries)[pData(gene_summaries)$Dx == "CTL", "ShortName"]
fndc3a_plot_data[fndc3a_plot_data$SampleID %in% controls, "SampleType"] <- "Controls"
head(fndc3a_plot_data)

# 3.8 Generate FNDC3A plot
cols <- c("#FDAE6B", "gray", rep(c("#4292C6", "gray"), 6), rep(c("#A6D854", "gray"), 30))
pdf(paste0(outpath, "/4.1_boxplot_FNDC3A_gene_vs_transcripts_vs_exons_residuals.pdf"), width = 15, height = 7)
sp <- ggplot(fndc3a_plot_data, aes(x = EnsemblID, y = Expression, fill = SampleType)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 22) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 22), panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, size = 2), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("Gene expression") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = median(fndc3a_plot_data[fndc3a_plot_data$EnsemblID == "FNDC3A", "Expression"]), linetype = "dashed") 
sp + facet_wrap(. ~ Type, scales = "free")
dev.off()

pdf(paste0(outpath, "/4.1_boxplot_FNDC3A_gene_vs_transcripts_vs_exons_residuals_same_size.pdf"), width = 26, height = 8)
sp + facet_grid(. ~ Type, scales = "free", space = "free") + scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0.5))
dev.off()

# calculate the difference as the median expression of cases substracted by the median expression of controls
differences <- data.frame()
for(id in unique(fndc3a_plot_data$EnsemblID)) {
  diff <- median(fndc3a_plot_data[fndc3a_plot_data$EnsemblID == id & fndc3a_plot_data$SampleType == "Cases",]$Expression) - median(fndc3a_plot_data[fndc3a_plot_data$EnsemblID == id & fndc3a_plot_data$SampleType == "Controls",]$Expression)
  row <- cbind(id, diff)
  differences <- rbind(differences, row)
}
differences$diff <- as.numeric(levels(differences$diff))[differences$diff]
differences <- differences[order(differences$diff, decreasing = T), ]
as.vector(differences$id)
```


# Exon expression quantitative trait score (exon eQT-Scores)

For gene HKDC1 (ENSG00000156510.11), which has two protein-coding transcripts, we have an exon eQT-Score hit for BIP-2019, CDG2-2019 GWAS, MDD3-2019 and SCZ2-2014. With all, except BIP-2019 (exon ENSE00003249902.1, 6th exon in both transcripts), having a hit with exon ENSE00001096309.1, which is the second-last exon of the longest (18 exons) transcript of HKDC1. To plot the polygenic risk scores (PRS) for the four mentioned GWASs against exon expression we need to load the PRS and merge them to the phenotype dataset. 
```{r, echo = F}
# BIP-2019 PRS
prs_bip <- GetPRS(paste0(prs_path, "/BIP-2019/pmb_info06_all_chr_maf0.01_IDs_changed_noDup_final_BIP-2019_PRSice-2_PRS.all.score"))
# CDG2-2018 PRS
prs_cdg2 <- GetPRS(paste0(prs_path, "/CDG2-2019/pmb_info06_all_chr_maf0.01_IDs_changed_noDup_final_CDG2-2019_PRSice-2_PRS.all.score"))
# MDD3-2019 PRS
prs_mdd3 <- GetPRS(paste0(prs_path, "/MDD3-2019/pmb_info06_all_chr_maf0.01_IDs_changed_noDup_final_MDD3-2019_PRSice-2_PRS.all.score"))
# SCZ2-2014 PRS
prs_scz2 <- GetPRS(paste0(prs_path, "/SCZ2-2014/pmb_info06_all_chr_maf0.01_IDs_changed_noDup_final_SCZ2-2014_PRSice-2_PRS.all.score"))
# Then, we add the four PRSs to pData of the gene expression dataset.
pData(exon_summaries) <- plyr::join(pData(exon_summaries), as.data.frame(prs_bip))
colnames(pData(exon_summaries))[length(pData(exon_summaries)[1,])] <- "PRS.BIP"
pData(exon_summaries) <- plyr::join(pData(exon_summaries), as.data.frame(prs_cdg2))
colnames(pData(exon_summaries))[length(pData(exon_summaries)[1,])] <- "PRS.CDG2"
pData(exon_summaries) <- plyr::join(pData(exon_summaries), as.data.frame(prs_mdd3))
colnames(pData(exon_summaries))[length(pData(exon_summaries)[1,])] <- "PRS.MDD3"
pData(exon_summaries) <- plyr::join(pData(exon_summaries), as.data.frame(prs_scz2))
colnames(pData(exon_summaries))[length(pData(exon_summaries)[1,])] <- "PRS.SCZ2"
pheno <- pData(exon_summaries)[, c("ShortName", "PRS.BIP", "PRS.CDG2", "PRS.MDD3", "PRS.SCZ2", "Dx", "Diagnosis")]
pheno$Diagnosis <- factor(pheno$Diagnosis, levels = c("CTL", "BPD", "MDD", "SCZ"))
head(pheno)
```

Then, we also need to load the residuals of the exon expression for each eQTS and save them all into a data frame. Here, we need to save exon ENSE00003249902 for the BIP-2019 eQTS and exon ENSE00001096309 for CDG2-2019, MDD3-2019 and SCZ2-2014 eQTS.

```{r}
prs <- t(t(as.data.frame(prs)))
```

## FUMA

### Load data

First, we will load the gene set enrichment analysis datasets (we will only load the exon eQTS results) and reduce it to the KEGG pathways. We will also save all hit gene sets into a list, so we know for which gene sets we need to filter all datasets.
```{r, echo = F}
# FUMA results
hit_gene_sets <- list()
asd_eqts <- fread(paste0(fuma_path, "/4.4_exon_eQTS_results/ASD-2019/GS.txt"))
asd_eqts$GeneRatio <- asd_eqts$N_overlap / asd_eqts$N_genes
asd_eqts <- asd_eqts[asd_eqts$Category == "4_kegg_entrez_no_disease_pathways.txt" & asd_eqts$adjP < 0.05, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio", "adjP")]
#hit_gene_sets <- asd_eqts$GeneSet
cdg_eqts <- fread(paste0(fuma_path, "/4.4_exon_eQTS_results/CDG-2019/GS.txt"))
cdg_eqts$GeneRatio <- cdg_eqts$N_overlap / cdg_eqts$N_genes
cdg_eqts <- cdg_eqts[cdg_eqts$Category == "4_kegg_entrez_no_disease_pathways.txt" & cdg_eqts$adjP < 0.05, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio", "adjP")]
hit_gene_sets <- c(hit_gene_sets, cdg_eqts$GeneSet)
mdd_eqts <- fread(paste0(fuma_path, "/4.4_exon_eQTS_results/MDD-2019/GS.txt"))
mdd_eqts$GeneRatio <- mdd_eqts$N_overlap / mdd_eqts$N_genes
mdd_eqts <- mdd_eqts[mdd_eqts$Category == "4_kegg_entrez_no_disease_pathways.txt" & mdd_eqts$adjP < 0.05, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio", "adjP")]
hit_gene_sets <- c(hit_gene_sets, mdd_eqts$GeneSet)
scz_eqts <- fread(paste0(fuma_path, "/4.4_exon_eQTS_results/SCZ-2014/GS.txt"))
scz_eqts$GeneRatio <- scz_eqts$N_overlap / scz_eqts$N_genes
scz_eqts <- scz_eqts[scz_eqts$Category == "4_kegg_entrez_no_disease_pathways.txt" & scz_eqts$adjP < 0.05, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio", "adjP")]
hit_gene_sets <- c(hit_gene_sets, scz_eqts$GeneSet)
aabms_eqts <- fread(paste0(fuma_path, "/4.4_exon_eQTS_results/AABMS/GS.txt"))
aabms_eqts$GeneRatio <- aabms_eqts$N_overlap / aabms_eqts$N_genes
aabms_eqts <- aabms_eqts[aabms_eqts$Category == "4_kegg_entrez_no_disease_pathways.txt" & aabms_eqts$adjP < 0.05, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio", "adjP")]
#hit_gene_sets <- c(hit_gene_sets, aabms_eqts$GeneSet)
abms_eqts <- fread(paste0(fuma_path, "/4.4_exon_eQTS_results/ABMS/GS.txt"))
abms_eqts$GeneRatio <- abms_eqts$N_overlap / abms_eqts$N_genes
abms_eqts <- abms_eqts[abms_eqts$Category == "4_kegg_entrez_no_disease_pathways.txt" & abms_eqts$adjP < 0.05, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio", "adjP")]
hit_gene_sets <- c(hit_gene_sets, abms_eqts$GeneSet)
bms_eqts <- fread(paste0(fuma_path, "/4.4_exon_eQTS_results/BMS/GS.txt"))
bms_eqts$GeneRatio <- bms_eqts$N_overlap / bms_eqts$N_genes
bms_eqts <- bms_eqts[bms_eqts$Category == "4_kegg_entrez_no_disease_pathways.txt" & bms_eqts$adjP < 0.05, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio", "adjP")]
#hit_gene_sets <- c(hit_gene_sets, bms_eqts$GeneSet)
index <- fread(paste0(fuma_path, "/4.5_index_patients_results/GS.txt"))
index$GeneRatio <- index$N_overlap / index$N_genes
index <- index[index$Category == "KEGG_without_diseases" & index$adjP < 0.05, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio", "adjP")]
hit_gene_sets <- c(hit_gene_sets, index$GeneSet)
length(unique(hit_gene_sets))
```

Now, we can generate the dataset for the plot using all gene sets that had a hit in at least one eQTS. We will set the p-value to 1 if no p-value for a gene set was given. 
```{r}
plot_data <- t(as.data.frame(hit_gene_sets))
colnames(plot_data) <- "GeneSet"
# get CDG hits
plot_data <- merge(plot_data, cdg_eqts[, c("GeneSet", "adjP")], by = "GeneSet", all.x = T)
colnames(plot_data) <- c("GeneSet", "CDG")
# get MDD hits
plot_data <- merge(plot_data, mdd_eqts[, c("GeneSet", "adjP")], by = "GeneSet", all.x = T)
colnames(plot_data) <- c("GeneSet", "CDG", "MDD")
# get SCZ hits
plot_data <- merge(plot_data, scz_eqts[, c("GeneSet", "adjP")], by = "GeneSet", all.x = T)
colnames(plot_data) <- c("GeneSet", "CDG", "MDD", "SCZ")
# get ABMS hits
plot_data <- merge(plot_data, abms_eqts[, c("GeneSet", "adjP")], by = "GeneSet", all.x = T)
colnames(plot_data) <- c("GeneSet", "CDG", "MDD", "SCZ", "ABMS")
# get index hits
plot_data <- merge(plot_data, index[, c("GeneSet", "adjP")], by = "GeneSet", all.x = T)
colnames(plot_data) <- c("GeneSet", "CDG", "MDD", "SCZ", "ABMS", "Index")
# order dataset and reshape
plot_data <- plot_data[!duplicated(plot_data), ]
plot_data <- reshape2::melt(data = plot_data, id.vars = "GeneSet")

### get gene ratios
grs <- t(as.data.frame(hit_gene_sets))
colnames(grs) <- "GeneSet"
# get CDG hits
grs <- merge(grs, cdg_eqts[, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio")], by = "GeneSet", all.x = T)
colnames(grs) <- c("GeneSet", "CDG")
# get MDD hits
grs <- merge(grs, mdd_eqts[, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio")], by = "GeneSet", all.x = T)
colnames(grs) <- c("GeneSet", "CDG", "MDD")
# get SCZ hits
grs <- merge(grs, scz_eqts[, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio")], by = "GeneSet", all.x = T)
colnames(grs) <- c("GeneSet", "CDG", "MDD", "SCZ")
# get ABMS hits
grs <- merge(grs, abms_eqts[, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio")], by = "GeneSet", all.x = T)
colnames(grs) <- c("GeneSet", "CDG", "MDD", "SCZ", "ABMS")
# get Index hits
grs <- merge(grs, index[, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio")], by = "GeneSet", all.x = T)
colnames(grs) <- c("GeneSet", "CDG", "MDD", "SCZ", "ABMS", "Index")
# order dataset and reshape
grs <- grs[!duplicated(grs), ]
grs <- reshape2::melt(data = grs, id.vars = "GeneSet")

plot_data <- merge(plot_data, grs, by = c("GeneSet", "variable"))
colnames(plot_data) <- c("GeneSet", "eQTS", "adjP", "GeneRatio")
plot_data$log_adjP <- -log(plot_data$adjP)
plot_data <- plot_data[!(duplicated(plot_data)), ]
plot_data$GeneSet <- factor(plot_data$GeneSet, levels = rev(levels(plot_data$GeneSet)))
plot_data$eQTS <- factor(plot_data$eQTS, levels = c("SCZ", "CDG", "MDD", "ABMS", "Index"))
plot_data$Group <- ifelse(plot_data$eQTS != "Index", "eQTS", "Index")
```

### Balloonplot

Generate a balloonplot including the results of the enriched (FDR <= 0.05) KEGG gene sets. 
```{r, echo = F}
ggballoonplot(plot_data, x = "eQTS", y = "GeneSet", fill = "log_adjP", size = "GeneRatio", ggtheme = theme_bw(), legend.title = "-log10(adjP)", size.range = c(1, 6), color = "lightgray") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D", direction = 1) +
  facet_grid(~ Group, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x")
ggsave(file = paste0(outpath, "/4.2_balloonplot_exon_eQTS_FUMA_KEGG.pdf"), width = 6.2, height = 17)
# delete unnecessary data
rm(aabms_eqts, abms_eqts, bms_eqts, asd_eqts, cdg_eqts, mdd_eqts, scz_eqts, grs, hit_gene_set, index, plot_data)
```


# Age DEGenes

## Load data

First, we need to load the gene-based (gDEGenes), transcript-based (tDEGenes) and exon-based (eDEGenes) differentially expressed genes for age. Then, we filter the data for only significant (FDR < 10%) genes. 
```{r, echo = F}
# gene-level
gDEGenes_age <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/1.1_diff_expr_genes_for_age.csv"), select = c("Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol", "FDR estimate"), data.table = F)
bck_gDEGenes_age <- unique(sort(gDEGenes_age$`Ensembl Gene ID`))
gDEGenes_age <- gDEGenes_age[gDEGenes_age$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, ]

# transcript-level
tDEGenes_age <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/2.4_diff_expr_transcripts_for_age_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), select = c("FDR estimate", "Gene Symbol", "Ensembl Gene ID"), data.table = F)
bck_tDEGenes_age <- unique(sort(tDEGenes_age$`Ensembl Gene ID`))
tDEGenes_age <- tDEGenes_age[tDEGenes_age$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, ]

# exon-level
eDEGenes_age <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/3.4_diff_expr_exons_for_age_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), select = c("FDR estimate", "Gene Symbol", "Ensembl Gene ID"), data.table = F)
bck_eDEGenes_age <- unique(sort(eDEGenes_age$`Ensembl Gene ID`))
eDEGenes_age <- eDEGenes_age[eDEGenes_age$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, ]
```

## Overlap to known ageing genes

Now, we are interested in how many of the differentially expressed age genes are overlapping to a database of known ageing genes for human. Therefore, we use the ageing gene database called GenAge and download all human age related genes from their website: https://genomics.senescence.info/download.html

First, we load the known ageing genes from the GenAge database. 
```{r}
ageing_genes <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/datasets/2019_Human_Ageing_Genomic_Resources/genage_human.csv", select = "symbol", data.table = F)
```

Then, we calculate the overlap to the single age DEGenes from our dataset:
```{r, echo = F}
# gDEGenes
print(paste0("Age gDEGenes overlap to known age genes: ", length(intersect(ageing_genes$symbol, gDEGenes_age$`Gene Symbol`))))

# tDEGenes
print(paste0("Age tDEGenes overlap to known age genes: ", length(intersect(ageing_genes$symbol, tDEGenes_age$`Gene Symbol`))))

# eDEGenes
print(paste0("Age eDEGenes overlap to known age genes: ", length(intersect(ageing_genes$symbol, eDEGenes_age$`Gene Symbol`))))
```

Now, we can also check the significance (p-value) of the overlap from our age DEGenes to the known age genes. Therefore, we first need to generate a contingency table and then run Fisher's exact test:

1. gDEGenes: `r FishersExactTest(gDEGenes_age[, "Gene Symbol"], ageing_genes$symbol, bck_gDEGenes_age)`
2. tDEGenes: `r FishersExactTest(tDEGenes_age[, "Gene Symbol"], ageing_genes$symbol, bck_tDEGenes_age)`
3. eDEGenes: `r FishersExactTest(eDEGenes_age[, "Gene Symbol"], ageing_genes$symbol, bck_eDEGenes_age)`

## VENN diagram

When, we will generate a VENN diagram for the overlap of found eDEGenes, tDEGenes and eDEGenes for age and save it into a pdf file.  
```{r, echo = F}
gDEGenes_age <- unique(gDEGenes_age$`Ensembl Gene ID`)
tDEGenes_age <- unique(tDEGenes_age$`Ensembl Gene ID`)
eDEGenes_age <- unique(eDEGenes_age$`Ensembl Gene ID`)
# show plot
grid.newpage()
overrideTriple = T
draw.triple.venn(area1 = length(gDEGenes_age), area2 = length(tDEGenes_age), 
                 area3 = length(eDEGenes_age), euler.d = F, scaled = F, lty = "blank", 
                 n12 = length(intersect(gDEGenes_age, tDEGenes_age)), 
                 n23 = length(intersect(tDEGenes_age, eDEGenes_age)), 
                 n13 = length(intersect(gDEGenes_age, eDEGenes_age)),
                 n123 = length(intersect(gDEGenes_age, intersect(tDEGenes_age, 
                                                                 eDEGenes_age))),  
                 category = c(paste("gDEGenes", length(gDEGenes_age), sep = "\n"), 
                              paste("tDEGenes", length(tDEGenes_age), sep = "\n"), 
                              paste("eDEGenes", length(eDEGenes_age), sep = "\n")), 
                 fill = c(col_gdegene, col_tdegene, col_edegene))
dev.off()
# save plot
pdf(paste0(outpath, "/4_VENN_DEGenes_for_age.pdf"))
grid.newpage()
overrideTriple = T
draw.triple.venn(area1 = length(gDEGenes_age), area2 = length(tDEGenes_age), 
                 area3 = length(eDEGenes_age), euler.d = F, scaled = F, lty = "blank", 
                 n12 = length(intersect(gDEGenes_age, tDEGenes_age)), 
                 n23 = length(intersect(tDEGenes_age, eDEGenes_age)), 
                 n13 = length(intersect(gDEGenes_age, eDEGenes_age)),
                 n123 = length(intersect(gDEGenes_age, intersect(tDEGenes_age, 
                                                                 eDEGenes_age))),  
                 category = c(paste("gDEGenes", length(gDEGenes_age), sep = "\n"), 
                              paste("tDEGenes", length(tDEGenes_age), sep = "\n"), 
                              paste("eDEGenes", length(eDEGenes_age), sep = "\n")), 
                 fill = c(col_gdegene, col_tdegene, col_edegene))
dev.off()
# delete unnecessary data
rm(gDEGenes_age, tDEGenes_age, eDEGenes_age, ageing_gene, p)
```

```{r, echo = F}
                 n13 = length(intersect(gDEGenes_c2, eDEGenes_c2)), euler.d = F, scaled = F,
                 n123 = length(intersect(gDEGenes_c2, intersect(tDEGenes_c2, eDEGenes_c2))),
                 category = c(paste("gDEGenes", length(gDEGenes_c2), sep = "\n"), 
                              paste("tDEGenes", length(tDEGenes_c2), sep = "\n"), 
                              paste("eDEGenes", length(eDEGenes_c2), sep = "\n")), 
                 fill = c(col_gdegene, col_tdegene, col_edegene))
dev.off()
# delete unnecessary data
rm(gDEGenes_c2, tDEGenes_c2, eDEGenes_c2)
```


# FUMA

## Tissue enrichment 

### Load data

First, we will load the dataset for the tissue enrichment analysis for the eDEGenes (no results for tDEGenes).
```{r, echo = F}
# FUMA eDEGene results
eDEGenes_fuma_gtex <- fread(paste0(fuma_path,"/4.3_eDEGenes_result/gtex_v8_ts_DEG.txt"))
eDEGenes_fuma_gtex <- eDEGenes_fuma_gtex[eDEGenes_fuma_gtex$adjP < 0.05, ]
eDEGenes_fuma_gtex$log_adjP <- -log10(eDEGenes_fuma_gtex$adjP)
eDEGenes_fuma_gtex <- eDEGenes_fuma_gtex[eDEGenes_fuma_gtex$Category == "DEG.twoside", ]
eDEGenes_fuma_gtex <- eDEGenes_fuma_gtex[order(eDEGenes_fuma_gtex$GeneSet, decreasing = T), ]
eDEGenes_fuma_gtex <- as.data.frame(separate_rows(eDEGenes_fuma_gtex, genes, sep = ":"))
```

As we also want to know, how many genes are up and down-regulated, we also need to load the eDEGene results from the differential expression analysis:
```{r}
load(paste0(results_path, "/3.4_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.RData"))
top_hits <- top_hits[top_hits$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, c("Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol", "LogFC")]
top_hits$Reg <- ifelse(top_hits$LogFC < 0, "Down", "Up")
top_hits$`Ensembl Gene ID` <- sapply(top_hits$`Ensembl Gene ID`, function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])
```

Now, we can calculate how many of the genes were up-/down-regulated and add it to the dataset. Then, we will transform the data into a ggplot readable format. 
```{r}
gtex_genes <- merge(eDEGenes_fuma_gtex, top_hits[, c("Ensembl Gene ID", "Reg")], by.x = "genes", by.y = "Ensembl Gene ID")
gtex_genes <- as.data.table(aggregate(Reg ~ GeneSet, data = gtex_genes, FUN = function(x){table(x)}))
eDEGenes_fuma_gtex <- merge(eDEGenes_fuma_gtex, gtex_genes, by = "GeneSet")[, c("GeneSet", "N_overlap", "log_adjP", "Reg.Down", "Reg.Up")]
eDEGenes_fuma_gtex <- eDEGenes_fuma_gtex[!duplicated(eDEGenes_fuma_gtex), ]
# Now, we need the percentage of up/down regulated genes for log_adjP
eDEGenes_fuma_gtex$Reg.Down <- (eDEGenes_fuma_gtex$log_adjP / eDEGenes_fuma_gtex$N_overlap) * eDEGenes_fuma_gtex$Reg.Down
eDEGenes_fuma_gtex$Reg.Up <- (eDEGenes_fuma_gtex$log_adjP / eDEGenes_fuma_gtex$N_overlap) * eDEGenes_fuma_gtex$Reg.Up
# And we need to form the data into ggplot format
eDEGenes_fuma_gtex_reg <- reshape2::melt(data = eDEGenes_fuma_gtex, id.vars = "GeneSet", measure.vars = c("Reg.Down", "Reg.Up"))
```
