# Gene set (Pathway) enrichment analysis

## Load data

First, we will read in the tDEGenes and eDEGenes for diagnosis. 
```{r, echo = F}
# gDEGenes
gDEGenes <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/1.1_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis.csv"), sep = "\t", select = c("Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol", "FDR estimate"), stringsAsFactors = F)
gDEGenes_top100 <- gDEGenes[1:100, c("Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol")]

# tDEGenes 
tDEGenes <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/2.4_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), sep = "\t", select = c("Ensembl Transcript ID", "Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol", "FDR estimate"), stringsAsFactors = F)
tDEGenes_top100 <- tDEGenes[1:100, c("Ensembl Transcript ID", "Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol")]
tDEGenes_fdr0.2 <- tDEGenes[tDEGenes$`FDR estimate` < 0.2, c("Ensembl Transcript ID", "Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol")]
tDEGenes_fdr0.3 <- tDEGenes[tDEGenes$`FDR estimate` < 0.3, c("Ensembl Transcript ID", "Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol")]
tDEGenes <- tDEGenes[tDEGenes$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, c("Ensembl Transcript ID", "Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol")]

# eDEGenes
eDEGenes <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/3.4_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), sep = "\t", select = c("Ensembl Exon ID", "Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol", "FDR estimate"), stringsAsFactors = F)

# save background gene number (all given genes from the dataset)
background_genes <- as.data.frame(eDEGenes[!is.na(eDEGenes$`Gene Symbol`) & eDEGenes$`Gene Symbol` != "", ])[, "Gene Symbol"]

# get only significant hits
eDEGenes_fdr0.2 <- eDEGenes[eDEGenes$`FDR estimate` < 0.2, c("Ensembl Exon ID", "Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol")]
eDEGenes_top100 <- eDEGenes[1:100, c("Ensembl Exon ID", "Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol")]
eDEGenes <- eDEGenes[eDEGenes$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, c("Ensembl Exon ID", "Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol")]

# get overlap of genes (based on Ensembl Gene IDs)
print(paste0("Number of overlapping ", length(unique(tDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " tDEGenes (FDR < 0.1) and ", length(unique(eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " eDEGenes (FDR < 0.1): ", length(intersect(tDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`, eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`))))
print(paste0("Number of overlapping ", length(unique(tDEGenes_fdr0.2$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " tDEGenes (FDR < 0.2) and ", length(unique(eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " eDEGenes (FDR < 0.1): ", length(intersect(tDEGenes_fdr0.2$`Ensembl Gene ID`, eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " (only gene not overlapping: ", setdiff(tDEGenes_fdr0.2$`Ensembl Gene ID`, eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`), ", ", setdiff(tDEGenes_fdr0.2$`Ensembl Gene ID`, eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`), ")"))
print(paste0("Number of overlapping ", length(unique(tDEGenes_fdr0.3$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " tDEGenes (FDR < 0.3) and ", length(unique(eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " eDEGenes (FDR < 0.1): ", length(intersect(tDEGenes_fdr0.3$`Ensembl Gene ID`, eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`))))
print(paste0("Number of overlapping ", length(unique(tDEGenes_fdr0.3$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " tDEGenes (FDR < 0.3) and ", length(unique(eDEGenes_fdr0.2$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " eDEGenes (FDR < 0.2): ", length(intersect(tDEGenes_fdr0.3$`Ensembl Gene ID`, eDEGenes_fdr0.2$`Ensembl Gene ID`))))
print(paste0("Number of overlapping top ", length(unique(tDEGenes_top100$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " tDEGenes and ", length(unique(eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " eDEGenes (FDR < 0.1): ", length(intersect(tDEGenes_top100$`Ensembl Gene ID`, eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`))))
print(paste0("Number of overlapping top ", length(unique(tDEGenes_top100$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " tDEGenes and ", length(unique(eDEGenes_fdr0.2$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " eDEGenes (FDR < 0.2): ", length(intersect(tDEGenes_top100$`Ensembl Gene ID`, eDEGenes_fdr0.2$`Ensembl Gene ID`))))
print(paste0("Number of overlapping top ", length(unique(gDEGenes_top100$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " gDEGenes and ", length(unique(eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " eDEGenes (FDR < 0.1): ", length(intersect(gDEGenes_top100$`Ensembl Gene ID`, eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`))))
print(paste0("Number of overlapping top ", length(unique(gDEGenes_top100$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " gDEGenes and ", length(unique(eDEGenes_fdr0.2$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " eDEGenes (FDR < 0.2): ", length(intersect(gDEGenes_top100$`Ensembl Gene ID`, eDEGenes_fdr0.2$`Ensembl Gene ID`))))
print(paste0("Number of overlapping top ", length(unique(gDEGenes_top100$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " gDEGenes and ", length(unique(tDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " tDEGenes (FDR < 0.1): ", length(intersect(gDEGenes_top100$`Ensembl Gene ID`, tDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`))))
print(paste0("Number of overlapping top ", length(unique(gDEGenes_top100$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " gDEGenes and ", length(unique(eDEGenes_top100$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " eDEGenes: ", length(intersect(gDEGenes_top100$`Ensembl Gene ID`, eDEGenes_top100$`Ensembl Gene ID`))))
print(paste0("Number of overlapping top ", length(unique(gDEGenes_top100$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " gDEGenes and ", length(unique(tDEGenes_top100$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), " tDEGenes: ", length(intersect(gDEGenes_top100$`Ensembl Gene ID`, tDEGenes_top100$`Ensembl Gene ID`))))
```

Now, we will check the minimum, maximum and median linear fold change. 
```{r}
# tDEGenes
tDEGenes <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/2.4_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F)
tDEGenes <- tDEGenes[tDEGenes$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, ]
tDEGenes$LinearFC <- 2^abs(tDEGenes$LogFC)
print(paste0("Linear FC: min = ", min(tDEGenes$LinearFC), ", median = ", median(tDEGenes$LinearFC), ", max = ", max(tDEGenes$LinearFC)))
# eDEGenes
eDEGenes <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/3.4_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F)
eDEGenes <- eDEGenes[eDEGenes$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, ]
eDEGenes$LinearFC <- 2^abs(eDEGenes$LogFC)
print(paste0("Linear FC: min = ", min(eDEGenes$LinearFC), ", median = ", median(eDEGenes$LinearFC), ", max = ", max(eDEGenes$LinearFC)))
```

Now, we will check, how many exons were first exons of the corresponding genes. On eproblem are the different transcripts per gene, so different exons can be different 
```{r}
# get the exon IDs and the exon number (position in the gene)
exons <- as.data.frame(gencode[gencode$type == "exon", ])[, c("exon_id", "exon_number")]
exons <- exons[!duplicated(exons), ]
# get the exon numbers for all exon IDs
eDEGenes_exons <- as.data.frame(unique(unlist(lapply(eDEGenes$`Ensembl Exon ID`, function(x) strsplit(x, "\\|")))))
colnames(eDEGenes_exons) <- "exon_id"
# get all exon numbers for eDEGenes
eDEGenes_numbers <- merge(eDEGenes_exons, exons, by = "exon_id" , all.x = T)
# PROBLEM: an exon ID can be on different positions for different transcripts, we jus want to count it once
```

## VENN overlap

Before, we perform the GSEA, we will generate a VENN diagram of the overlap of the tDEGenes and eDEGenes. As all six tDEGenes are also eDEGene hits, the VENN diagram should display a huge circle (2,224 eDEGenes) with a smaller circle (6 tDEGenes) inside. 
```{r, echo = F}
# show plot 
grid.newpage()
draw.pairwise.venn(area1 = length(unique(tDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), 
                   area2 = length(unique(eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), 
                   cross.area = length(intersect(unique(tDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`),
                                                 unique(eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`))), 
                   fill = c(col_tdegene, col_edegene),
                   category = c(paste("tDEGenes", length(unique(tDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`)),
                                      sep = "\n"), 
                                paste("eDEGenes", length(unique(eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`)),
                                      sep = "\n")), lty = "blank", cex = 2)
dev.off()
# save plot
pdf(paste0(outpath, "/4_VENN_tDEGenes_eDEGenes_overlap.pdf"))
grid.newpage()
draw.pairwise.venn(area1 = length(unique(tDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), 
                   area2 = length(unique(eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`)), 
                   cross.area = length(intersect(unique(tDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`),
                                                 unique(eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`))), 
                   fill = c(col_tdegene, col_edegene),
                   category = c(paste("tDEGenes", length(unique(tDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`)),
                                      sep = "\n"), 
                                paste("eDEGenes", length(unique(eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`)),
                                      sep = "\n")), lty = "blank", cex = 2)
dev.off()
```

## Load MSigDB

For the gene set enrichment, sometimes also called pathway enrichment, we will use the sub-collection of "Canonical pathways" from the "C2: curated gene sets" and the "c5: gene ontology (GO) gene sets" of the Molecular Signature DataBase (MSigDB) downloaded from the GSEA website: http://software.broadinstitute.org/gsea/downloads.jsp

We load the data as Gene Set Collections (multiple Gene Sets), where the gene set (pathway) name is the key and all included genes (symbols) of the gene set are stored in a list (value). It is similar to a dictionary in python or a hashmap in Java with a key (gene set name) and value (list of included genes) pair.
```{r, echo = F}
# load MSigDB c2 - canonical pathways
all_canonical <- getGmt("/storage/groups/ccm01/datasets/2020_MSigDB_v7.0/c2.cp.v7.0.symbols.gmt", 
                  collectionType = BroadCollection(category = "c2"),  
                  geneIdType = SymbolIdentifier())
# load MSigDB c5 - gene ontology (GO) 
all_go <- getGmt("/storage/groups/ccm01/datasets/2020_MSigDB_v7.0/c5.all.v7.0.symbols.gmt", 
                  collectionType = BroadCollection(category = "c5"),  
                  geneIdType = SymbolIdentifier())
```
<!-- **TODO:** As the gene symbols are not as sufficient as Ensembl Gene IDs, we will map the gene symbols to Ensembl IDs using the latest GENCODE file created on GRCh37 (hg19) release 19 (downloaded from: https://www.gencodegenes.org/human/release_19.html). --> 


## Gene set (Pathway) enrichment analysis

Now, we use the MGSA tool to find pathways which are enriched for our dataset. As we only have six hits on transcript level (6 tDEGenes), it does not make sense to run a pathway/gene set enrichment on these as no pathway will be enriched with such a low number of genes. So, we will do the enrichment analysis only on the 2223 eDEGene hits. 

### MSigDB - Canonical Pathways

```{r, echo = F}
cp_mgsa <- list()
for (gset in all_canonical) {
  t <- list(gset@geneIds)
 cp_mgsa <- c(cp_mgsa, t)
}
names(cp_mgsa) <- names(all_canonical)
set.seed(0)  # necessary to get the same results all the time!!
cp_res <- mgsa(o = as.character(unique(eDEGenes$`Gene Symbol`)[!is.na(unique(eDEGenes$`Gene Symbol`))]), sets = cp_mgsa, population = as.character(background_genes))
plot(cp_res)
dev.off()

mgsa_res_cp <- setsResults(cp_res)
head(mgsa_res_cp[order(mgsa_res_cp$estimate, decreasing = T),])
write.table(mgsa_res_cp, file = paste0(results_path, "/3.6_GSEA_MGSA_MSigDB_c2_canonical_pathways_results_eDEGenes.tsv"))
```

Generate a barplot for the top (significant: estimate > 0.5) pathway hits.  
```{r, echo = F}
# save only the significant pathways (score > 0.5)
mgsa_res_cp <- mgsa_res_cp[mgsa_res_cp$estimate > 0.5 & !is.na(mgsa_res_cp$estimate), ]
mgsa_res_cp <- mgsa_res_cp[!(row.names(mgsa_res_cp) == "NA"), ]
plot_mgsa_cp <- as.data.frame(mgsa_res_cp[order(mgsa_res_cp$estimate, decreasing = T), ])
## set the levels in order we want
g <- ggplot(data = plot_mgsa_cp, aes(x = reorder(row.names(plot_mgsa_cp), estimate), y = estimate)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity") + xlab("") + coord_flip() + theme_classic(base_size = 22) + theme(panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, size = 2), axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) + ggtitle("MsigDB: c2 - cp") + geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[2])
ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(outpath, "/3.6_barplot_eDEGenes_MSigDB_top10_enriched_c2_canonical_pathways.pdf"), width = 5, height = 2)
g
```

# Transcripts per Gene

Now, we will plot the distribution of Ensembl Transcript IDs per Ensembl Gene ID. We will plot the distribution in our filtered expression dataset as well as the original transcripts per gene found in GENCODE (for hg19). 
```{r, echo = F}
# get transcript per gene info for own data
features <- fData(transcript_summaries)[, c("transcript_id", "gene_id")]
features <- as.data.frame(separate_rows(features, transcript_id, gene_id, sep = "\\|"))
features <- features[!duplicated(features), ]
freqs <- as.data.frame(table(as.data.frame(table(features$gene_id))$Freq))

# get transcript per gene info for Gencode (filter exactly as in the preprocessing)
genes <- gencode[gencode$type == "transcript"]
genes <- as.data.frame(genes)[, c("gene_id", "transcript_id")]
genes <- genes[!duplicated(genes), ]
freqs2 <- as.data.frame(table(as.data.frame(table(genes$gene_id))$Freq))

# get tDEGenes freq
ids <- features[features$transcript_id %in% tDEGenes$`Ensembl Transcript ID`, "gene_id"]
tfeatures <- features[features$gene_id %in% ids, ]
tfeatures <- as.data.frame(separate_rows(tfeatures, transcript_id, gene_id, sep = "\\|"))
tfeatures <- tfeatures[!duplicated(tfeatures), ]
freqs3 <- as.data.frame(table(as.data.frame(table(tfeatures$gene_id))$Freq))
freqs3$Var1 <- as.numeric(freqs3$Var1)
freqs3$Freq <- as.numeric(freqs3$Freq)
print(paste0("Number of all tDEGene transcripts: ", sum(rowSums(freqs3[, c("Var1", "Freq")]))))

# merge all three datasets
tfreq <- merge(freqs, freqs2, by = "Var1", all = T)
tfreq <- merge(tfreq, freqs3, by = "Var1", all = T)
# change colnames
colnames(tfreq) <- c("TranscriptCount", "ExpressionFreq", "OriginalFreq", "tDEGeneFreq")
# melt into ggplot format
tfreq <- reshape2::melt(tfreq, id.vars = "TranscriptCount")
tfreq$TranscriptCount <- as.numeric(tfreq$TranscriptCount)
# remove rows with NA and change factor order
tfreq <- tfreq[complete.cases(tfreq), ]
tfreq$variable <- factor(tfreq$variable, levels = c("OriginalFreq", "ExpressionFreq", "tDEGeneFreq"))

g <- ggplot(tfreq, aes(x = TranscriptCount, y = value, color = variable)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 22) +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 22), legend.position = c(0.9, 0.9), legend.box.background = element_rect(colour = "black"), legend.title = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, size = 2), axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) +
  ggtitle("Transcripts") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.015, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Number of transcripts per gene", y = "Number of genes") +
  scale_color_manual(values = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[c(9, 4, 3)], labels = c("GENCODE", "Own genes", "tDEGenes"))
ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(outpath, "/2.4_plot_transcripts_per_gene_gencode_vs_own_data.pdf"))
g
# save tDEGenes transcript counts as result table
colnames(freqs3) <- c("#Transcripts", "#Genes")
freqs3$Type <- "tDEGenes"
write.table(freqs3, paste0(results_path, "/2.6_tDEGenes_transcript_counts.tsv"), sep = "\t")
rm(features, genes, freqs, freqs2, freqs3, tfreq)
```


# Exons per Gene

Now, we will plot the distribution of Ensembl Exon IDs per Ensembl Gene ID. We will plot the distribution in our filtered expression dataset as well as the original exons per gene found in GENCODE (for hg19). 
```{r, echo = F}
features <- fData(exon_summaries)[, c("exon_id", "gene_id")]
features <- as.data.frame(separate_rows(features, exon_id, gene_id, sep = "\\|"))
features <- features[!duplicated(features), ]
freqs <- as.data.frame(table(as.data.frame(table(features$gene_id))$Freq))

# load gene to transcript info from Gencode and filter exactly like in the preprocessing step
genes <- gencode[gencode$type == "exon"]
genes <- as.data.frame(genes)[, c("gene_id", "exon_id")]

# get only Ensembl gene IDs for which we have exons (see above)
genes <- genes[genes$gene_id %in% features$gene_id, ]
genes <- genes[!duplicated(genes), ]
freqs2 <- as.data.frame(table(as.data.frame(table(genes$gene_id))$Freq))

# get eDEGenes freq
ids <- features[features$exon_id %in% eDEGenes$`Ensembl Exon ID`, "gene_id"]
efeatures <- features[features$gene_id %in% ids, ]
efeatures <- as.data.frame(separate_rows(efeatures, exon_id, gene_id, sep = "\\|"))
efeatures <- efeatures[!duplicated(efeatures), ]
freqs3 <- as.data.frame(table(as.data.frame(table(efeatures$gene_id))$Freq))
freqs3$Var1 <- as.numeric(freqs3$Var1)
freqs3$Freq <- as.numeric(freqs3$Freq)
print(paste0("Number of all eDEGene exons: ", sum(rowSums(freqs3[, c("Var1", "Freq")]))))

# merge all three datasets
efreq <- merge(freqs, freqs2, by = "Var1", all = T)
efreq <- merge(efreq, freqs3, by = "Var1", all = T)
# change colnames
colnames(efreq) <- c("ExonCount", "ExpressionFreq", "OriginalFreq", "eDEGeneFreq")
# melt into ggplot format
efreq <- reshape2::melt(efreq, id.vars = "ExonCount")
efreq$ExonCount <- as.numeric(efreq$ExonCount)
# remove rows with NA and change factor order
efreq <- efreq[complete.cases(efreq), ]
efreq$variable <- factor(efreq$variable, levels = c("OriginalFreq", "ExpressionFreq", "eDEGeneFreq"))

g <- ggplot(efreq, aes(x = ExonCount, y = value, color = variable)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 22) +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 22), legend.position = c(0.9, 0.9), legend.box.background = element_rect(colour = "black"), legend.title = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, size = 2), axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) +
  ggtitle("Exons") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.015, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Number of exons per gene", y = "Number of genes") +
  scale_color_manual(values = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[c(9, 4, 3)], labels = c("GENCODE", "Own data", "eDEGenes"))
ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(outpath, "/3.4_plot_exons_per_gene_gencode_vs_own_data.pdf"))
g
# save eDEGenes exon counts as result table
freqs3$variable <- as.character("eDEGenes")
colnames(freqs3) <- c("#Exons", "#Genes", "Type")
write.table(freqs3, paste0(results_path, "/3.6_eDEGenes_exon_counts.tsv"), sep = "\t")
rm(features, genes, freqs, freqs2, freqs3, tfreq)
```
